instruction: Change Thunderbird settings to compose all new emails in plain text by default.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the compose format from HTML to plain text in Thunderbird. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify that the preference 'mail.identity.id1.compose_html' is set to false. This is a common configuration task similar in complexity to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks mail.identity.id1.compose_html preference is set to false
Getter extracts the right state: fetches Thunderbird prefs.js file containing compose format settings
Metric logic is correct: parses prefs.js, extracts key-value pairs, and compares against expected rule
Expected value is semantically correct: false means plain text composition (not HTML)
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if result file is None (not found)
Complete coverage: single preference fully determines compose format behavior
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type checker warns about Union return type from get_vm_file vs str parameter in metric, but runtime behavior is correct since multi=False returns single string path and metric handles None appropriately

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
